verdict.rationale: A state filing service could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on the front door and the ORION portal. Nothing documents any machine-readable specification.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
